en.title: Study shows volcano-salt lake interaction may form iron ore deposits
en.dek: Experimental research suggests simultaneous mineral formation in deposits like El Laco
facts: The Australian National University research examined what happens when volcanoes erupt through salt lakes
Experimental tests occurred at 0.4 gigapascals and temperatures between 1,000 and 1,200 degrees Celsius
Experimental geologist Dr. Michael Anenburg stated that proposed mineral formation routes are not necessarily mutually exclusive
El Laco in Chile shows massive ore bodies from iron-rich magnetite lava flows and pyroclastic deposits from 2 million years ago
Annual global iron ore production is roughly 2.5 billion metric tons
body: Researchers from the Australian National University conducted piston-cylinder experiments at 0.4 gigapascals and temperatures of 1,000 to 1,200 degrees Celsius
Dr. Shengchao Yan, lead author, stated that previous experimental work typically tested one ore-forming process at a time
The laboratory experiments suggested one integrated system and provided an explanation for IOA deposits occurring with evaporite and iron oxide-phosphorus-bearing sedimentary rocks
en.context: Magma-sediment reactions can provide insights into the debate over iron ore formation, and concentrated rare earth metals in iron-rich volcanic rocks could meet demand for new energy systems.

ko.title: 화산-염호 상호작용이 철광석 매장 형성 가능성 시사
ko.dek: 실험 연구는 엘 라코와 같은 매장지에서 광물이 동시에 형성될 수 있음을 시사
facts: 호주 국립대학교 연구는 화산이 염호를 뚫고 분출할 때 발생하는 현상을 조사함
실험 지질학자 마이클 아넨버그 박사는 제안된 광물 형성 경로가 반드시 상호 배타적이지 않다고 밝힘
칠레 엘 라코는 200만 년 전 철이 풍부한 자철광 용암류와 화산쇄설물에서 거대한 광체 보유
연간 전 세계 철광석 생산량은 약 25억 톤임
body: 호주 국립대학교 연구진은 0.4 기가파스칼 및 1,000~1,200°C 온도에서 피스톤 실린더 실험을 수행했다.
주 저자인 옌성차오 박사는 이전 실험 연구들이 보통 한 번에 하나의 광석 형성 과정을 테스트했었다고 밝혔다.
실험실 연구 결과는 하나의 통합된 시스템을 시사했으며, 증발암 및 산화철-인 함유 퇴적암과 함께 발생하는 IOA 광상에 대한 설명을 제공했다.
ko.context: 마그마-퇴적물 반응은 철광석 형성 논쟁에 대한 통찰을 제공할 수 있으며, 철이 풍부한 화산암에 농축된 희토류 금속은 신에너지 시스템의 수요를 충족시킬 수 있음

de.title: Studie: Wechselwirkung von Vulkane und Salzseen kann Eisenerz-Lagerstätten bilden
de.dek: Experimentelle Forschung deutet auf gleichzeitige Mineralbildung in Lagerstätten wie El Laco hin
facts: Die Australian National University untersuchte, was passiert, wenn Vulkane durch Salzseen brechen
Experimentelle Tests erfolgten bei 0,4 Gigapascal und Temperaturen zwischen 1.000 und 1.200 Grad Celsius
Der experimentelle Geologe Dr. Michael Anenburg erklärte, dass vorgeschlagene Mineralbildungswege nicht notwendigerweise gegenseitig ausschließen
El Laco in Chile zeigt massive Erz-Körper aus eisenreichem Magnetit-Lavastromen und pyroklastischen Ablagerungen von vor 2 Millionen Jahren
Die jährliche globale Eisenerz-Produktion beträgt etwa 2,5 Milliarden metrische Tonnen
body: Forscher der Australian National University führten Piston-Zylinder-Experimente bei 0,4 Gigapascal und Temperaturen zwischen 1.000 und 1.200 Grad Celsius durch
Dr. Shengchao Yan, der Hauptautor, erklärte, dass frühere experimentelle Arbeiten typischerweise nur einen ore-bildenden Prozess gleichzeitig untersuchten
Die Laborexperimente deuteten auf ein integriertes System hin und lieferten eine Erklärung für IOA-Vorkommen, die mit evaporitischen und eisenoxid-phosphorhaltigen Sedimentgesteinen auftreten
de.context: Magma-Sediment-Reaktionen können Aufschluss über die Debatte um Eisenerz-Bildung geben, und konzentrierte Seltenen-Erden in eisenreichen Vulkanen könnten den Bedarf für neue Energiesysteme decken. @@CAPTION||

problemsFixed: The headline is not a purely factual statement of what happened; it implies a conclusion rather than reporting the study's findings.
The dek is speculative and not a direct factual summary.
The body contains unattributed claims and uses evaluative framing ('rewriting').
The context uses evaluative framing ('long debated').
The body structure is repetitive and lacks the required sentence variation and actor-first opening.
The draft incorrectly attributes the finding about simultaneous processes to the study itself without proper attribution to Dr. Anenburg or the experimental results.
The draft fails to adhere to the required structure (actor-first opening for paragraphs, sentence variation).
